scope_definition: Local execution of web prototype (scripts/run_app_demo.py) with canned/test embeddings and clear disclaimer banner.
verified_capabilities: Interactive UI functional; Whisper embedding ingestion functional; confidence estimation functional; HITL verification functional; experience store functional.
active_blockers: None for local controlled academic demo. Disclaimers regarding research prototype must remain visible.
minimum_remediation: Maintain prominent UI banner stating research prototype only with no clinical validity.

scope_definition: Hardened application service with real-time microphone capture, packaged dependencies, and persistent model checkpoints.
verified_capabilities: Clean Python architecture in src/continual/; modular pipeline (app_pipeline.py); comprehensive regression test suite (561/561 passing).
active_blockers: 1. Live audio capture requires local Whisper inference service; 2. Candidate checkpoints in checkpoints/phase8_1/*.pt are unmaterialized placeholders; 3. Single-threaded demo HTTP server lacks production concurrency/auth.
minimum_remediation: 1. Serialize and hash candidate weights; 2. Implement FastAPI/FastStream async backend; 3. Add microphone audio validation and Whisper feature service.

scope_definition: Field deployment with atypical dysarthric speakers in supervised, non-emergency assisted-living or home environments.
verified_capabilities: Speaker isolation architecture designed; zero-unverified-learning review barrier functional; rollback governance designed.
active_blockers: 1. Participant consent, DUA, and ethics protocols not established for external cohorts; 2. Zero prospective clinical or field data acquired; 3. Data privacy and voice retention policies unwritten; 4. High false alarm rate on dysarthric speakers.
minimum_remediation: Obtain IRB/ethics protocol approval; execute formal prospective data collection; establish authenticated cloud/on-device privacy architecture.

scope_definition: Unsupervised dispatch of medical, police, or rescue services based on atypical speech recognition.
verified_capabilities: Strict mathematical definition of FER safety ceiling; forensic recognition of clinical infeasibility.
active_blockers: 1. Safety-Infeasible operating point: emergency recall is 10-20% (over 80% of true emergencies missed); 2. Emergency precision is 7-9% (over 90% of triggered alerts are false alarms); 3. Dysarthric speaker variation causes severe FER violations (>25%); 4. Zero independent confirmatory evaluation; 5. Regulatory/medical device assessment absent.
minimum_remediation: FUNDAMENTAL RESEARCH RE-ENGINEERING REQUIRED: Multimodal sensor fusion (accelerometry, heart rate), end-to-end dysarthric phonetic fine-tuning, and prospective clinical validation trial.
